selection.include: Tracked paths from git ls-files. idiom_census counts .flow files by source-purpose directory. feature_evidence resolves backtick path references in docs/project/idiom-modernization/FEATURE-SURFACES.md. parse_coverage and doc_coverage use their existing inventories.
selection.exclude: Untracked, ignored and uncommitted files are not part of a pin. compiler fixtures and examples/verify are inventoried as compiler_fixture and proof_corpus. Those classes stay out of an adoption denominator. A resolved path is an anchor. That anchor does not prove the feature works or is shipped.
selection.dirty_worktree: git status --porcelain must be empty for --write and --check. A dirty tree may be labelled in the default JSON report and is otherwise refused.

gaps_policy: Missing evidence stays unverified. A failing census tool is recorded as a baseline failure. That failure is not a shipped or absent feature label.
